title: Washington Fishing Map
identified: 2026-10-18, named by Daniel when asking for improvements
what: Five-tab site on one URL (Week | Map | Year | Spots | Counts). Map: Recent reports (eight SW Washington salmon waters and the Skagit, rated from sourced catch reports; the Skagit's is stale, from 2026-10-10; WDFW notices on tapped rivers), Typical season (540 statewide sites by the app's seasonal timing) and Spawning (75 WDFW salmon viewing sites by month), under one thin control bar. Week: open seasons, this week's reports, new WDFW rules, coming up, a 7-day bundled NOAA tide table (26 stations; also Tides today on marine site sheets of the map) and spots. Year: Washington Fishing Year. Spots: Three Friends Fishing Hole. Counts: SW Washington creel table. Counts and timing never mix with ratings.
note: Refresh by PASSING THIS URL with file_path=Artifacts/salmon-rivers/index.html and files= any changed paths from `files` (files left out are kept on the live page). Read the live version first.
